changelog:
Version 1.0.0 of skill-router introduces a major redesign:

- Replaces simple skill suggestion with a structured Analysis Plan: matches discovered documents to relevant compliance skills using dynamic reasoning.
- Inputs: accepts one or more document manifests and a live skills directory path, reading skill frontmatter dynamically each run (no static lookup tables).
- Outputs: generates a detailed markdown table and structured JSON, explicitly reporting matching skills and identifying toolkit-coverage gaps for any unmatched documents.
- Enforces strict guardrails: only matches grounded in specific document and skill-description phrases are recommended; general-purpose or fallback suggestions are not allowed.
- Deprecates previous reference-driven routing, focusing now on document-to-skill applicability in compliance workflows.
